- 91 HTML files inventoried on the review branch.
- 5 archive/duplicate shortcut pages checked; all five destinations exist in the repository.

## Confirmed editorial findings

- `html/cinema_900 (1).html`: 137 headings across the three 300-film lists; country grouping is present, but the film records are not semantic tables.
- `html/complete_movie_encyclopedia.html`: 108 headings and 57 source sections; many records remain grouped in long paragraphs rather than individually structured entries.
- `html/complete_movie_ratings.html`: repeated column labels were being treated as headings; corrected as above, but record groups remain flattened.
- `html/complete_movie_ratings_647.html`: repeated column labels were being treated as headings; corrected as above, but record groups remain flattened.
- `html/sensitive_cinema.html`: repeated metadata and lesson labels were inflating the contents navigation; corrected as above.
- The two `All_Film_Collections_Combined_compressed` PDFs are exact duplicates. The alternate HTML URL is an archive shortcut to the canonical conversion.

## Remaining verification limits

- The canonical `html/All_Film_Collections_Combined_compressed.html` is approximately 1.8 MB; the GitHub content connector returned no readable body for it. Its complete page content could not be inspected in this pass.
- The original PDF/Word binaries were inventoried but could not be rendered and compared page-by-page against every converted HTML file through the available GitHub content interface. Source-level fidelity is therefore not certified.
- No real browser/device session was available for rendered desktop/mobile, keyboard, filter, theme, or accessibility testing. This report does not claim visual QA or a live Pages deployment check.
- The remaining flattened film and rating records still deserve a dedicated semantic-table/card redesign, preserving every original value and avoiding fabricated metadata.

## Review status

This is a documented editorial review pass with title and heading-hierarchy corrections committed to the review branch. It is not a claim that all 91 pages have passed full source-to-output fact checking or final human/browser QA.
